accused_victim_relationship.reason: Spouse and in-law relations are right; 'Acquaintance' is unsupported and the family ties are not named.

offence_category.reason: Case is treated as a dowry death under s.304-B IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: IPC 304-B, 498-A and DPA ss.3 and 4 are all cited; Evidence Act ss.113-A/B are omitted but not wrong.

weapon.correct_value: Poison (Organo Chloro Insecticide and Ethyl Alcohol found in viscera); burning by fire
weapon.quote: pieces of stomach, intestine, liver, kidney and spleen contained Organo Chloro Insecticide and Ethile Alcohol poisons
weapon.reason: 'None mentioned' ignores the poison and fire described as the means of death.

evidence_type.correct_value: Circumstantial, medical (post-mortem and autopsy), chemical examiner report, oral testimony
evidence_type.quote: The circumstantial evidence leads to the guilt of the accused persons
evidence_type.reason: Circumstantial and medical evidence are right; no recovery evidence is mentioned, and oral and chemical evidence are omitted.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Cruelty and dowry harassment and death in the in-laws' house are supported.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under s.304-B IPC (life) for Shim and Aan Singh; s.498-A IPC for all; DPA ss.3 and 4 for all; fines of Rs.500
trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced them to imprisonment for life, and further convicted all the appellants under Section 498-A IPC
trial_court_outcome.reason: Omits the DPA convictions and that the life term applied only to two accused; fines also omitted.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Conviction and sentence of appellant Nos.1 and 2 upheld; two co-accused acquitted
high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court while acquitting the two co-accused (appellant Nos.2 & 3 herein), upheld the conviction and sentence of appellant Nos.1 & 2
high_court_outcome.reason: Omits that the High Court acquitted the co-accused; upholding applied only to two appellants.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal dismissed; conviction of Shim Singh and Aan Singh upheld; co-accused not convicted
final_outcome.quote: The guilt of the accused persons i.e. the appellant Nos.1 & 2 herein, under Section 304-B IPC has been successfully established.
final_outcome.reason: 'Convicted' omits that only two appellants remained convicted and the others were acquitted.

offence_finally_established.quote: The guilt of the accused persons i.e. the appellant Nos.1 & 2 herein, under Section 304-B IPC has been successfully established.
offence_finally_established.reason: Court held s.304-B IPC dowry death established against Nos.1 and 2.

imprisonment_type.quote: sentenced them to imprisonment for life

imprisonment_years.reason: No term in years is given for the life sentence.
